description:
Job Description
In this role, you’ll help share Wix’s story in AI, technology, and brand through compelling social media and short-form video content. As part of the Public Relations team, you’ll collaborate closely with product, marketing, and design teams to amplify Wix’s innovation, brand, and leadership across social platforms. In your day-to-day, you will:

• Create short videos showcasing Wix products and brand, using AI and video editing tools

• Monitor AI, tech, brand, and industry trends to identify relevant content opportunities

• Write and edit social media posts tailored to platforms like X and LinkedIn

• Collaborate with internal teams to craft accurate and engaging narratives

• Ensure all content aligns with Wix’s messaging, brand, and PR strategy

• Track engagement metrics to inform and refine content strategies

Qualifications
• Current student in communication or technical fields, such as industrial engineering and management, ideally in the second year of studies

• Genuine interest in AI, technology, branding, and industry trends, with hands-on experience using AI and video editing tools

• Proven ability to create compelling short-form video content

• Familiarity with social platforms, including X and LinkedIn, and active engagement with industry trends

• Strong writing skills with the ability to translate complex topics into engaging and clear content

• Self-motivated and proactive, with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively

Additional Information
Wix makes it possible for anyone to succeed online. Since 2006, we’ve grown to around 4,400 employees in 22 countries, launched over 40 products, and serve over 299 million users and their visitors worldwide. At Wix, we push you to innovate and evolve in non-traditional ways. We operate in collaborative, high-performing teams, building cutting-edge products and leveraging AI to redefine how our users create, manage and grow their dreams online.

Although we’re already industry leaders in web creation and business, our work is nowhere near done. Our goal is to become the main engine of the Internet so we can create a more open web for all.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

Company Description
We are Wix’s Public Relations team. Our role is to craft and execute impactful communication strategies that elevate Wix's brand awareness and strengthen its market presence. As the face of Wix to the media and public, we ensure our messaging resonates across all channels. We collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to create consistent and compelling narratives that highlight Wix’s innovation, brand, and leadership in the industry.
title: Social Media Specialist AI, Tech & Brand – Student
